{{Top|leg}}
The '''survey module''' was a [[Mission Function Module]] designed to be used with the [[modular taskforce cruiser]]. Costing one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], it was used to rapidly explore and chart entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. With a centralized [[Computer/Legends|computer]] for quick analysis, the crew of the survey module could explore and analyze a planet within a standard 24-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. This included determining possible colony sites, mineral and agricultural resources, and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] routes to nearby [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]. The survey module was crewed by 2,000 [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], 1,500 [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], and 5,000 [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Equipment included over a hundred [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and 500 [[Explorer droid/Legends|explorer droids]] for observation, as well as five [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray blastboats]] and six [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] for defense.
